# Build 01 · RNA-seq System

End-to-end RNA-seq workflow for reproducible transcriptomics analysis and interpretation.

## System Path

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD

    A[FASTQ Files]
    B[FastQC]

    H[Exploration]
    I[Differential Expression]
    J[Interpretation]
    K[Quarto Reporting]

    A --> B
    B --> C
    C --> D
    D --> E
    E --> F
    F --> G
    G --> H
    H --> I
    I --> J
    J --> K
```
